title: MRI Hydronephrosis Study
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare a rapid noncontrast MRI protocol not requiring sedation to ultrasound in the assessment of hydronephrosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children 2 years of age and younger
* Diagnosed with hydronephrosis and scheduled for an ultrasound scan

Exclusion Criteria:

* Healthy subjects
